blocks.prompt: 18. If \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}\) and \(\frac{1}{c}\) are in A.P., show that the common difference is \(\frac{a - c}{2ac}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi proof hai. A.P. ka common difference \(d\) do saath wali terms ka farq hota hai.
Humein \(d\) ko sirf \(a\) aur \(c\) mein likhna hai, \(b\) ke baghair.
Plan: \(d\) ko do tareeqon se likh kar jama karna, taake \(\frac{1}{b}\) cancel ho jaye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}\) A.P. mein hain.
Saabit karna hai: \(d = \frac{a - c}{2ac}\).
Tareeqa: \(d = \frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{a}\) bhi hai aur \(d = \frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{b}\) bhi. Jawab mein \(b\) nahi hai, is liye humein koi aisa qadam chahiye jo \(b\) ko khatam kar de.

Common difference do dafa likhein
\[d = \dfrac{1}{b} - \dfrac{1}{a} \quad (1)\]
\[d = \dfrac{1}{c} - \dfrac{1}{b} \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Doosri minus pehli, aur teesri minus doosri, dono \(d\) ke barabar hain; yehi A.P. ki pehchaan hai.

(1) aur (2) jama karein
\[2d = \dfrac{1}{c} - \dfrac{1}{a}\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(+\frac{1}{b}\) aur (2) mein \(-\frac{1}{b}\) hai; jama karne se cancel. Left side par \(d + d = 2d\). Yehi woh chaal hai jis se \(b\) gayab hua.

Simplify karein
\[2d = \dfrac{a - c}{ac}\]
\[d = \dfrac{a - c}{2ac}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{a}\) ka common denominator \(ac\): \(\frac{a}{ac} - \frac{c}{ac} = \frac{a - c}{ac}\). Phir dono taraf 2 se divide.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{a}\) ka top \(a - c\) hai, \(c - a\) nahi. Har fraction ko common denominator par le jate waqt doosre ka denominator upar multiply hota hai.

Tasdeeq: numbers rakh kar
\(a = 1,\ c = 3\) (sawal 17 se \(b = \frac{3}{2}\)):
\[d = \dfrac{2}{3} - 1 = -\dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\dfrac{a - c}{2ac} = \dfrac{1 - 3}{6} = -\dfrac{1}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Seedha farq aur formula, dono se \(-\frac{1}{3}\) aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: common difference \(\frac{a - c}{2ac}\) hai.
